title: Vowel Qualities
description: This unit compares full and reduced vowel signs and relates them to the spellings introduced earlier.

blocks.html: Pataḥ and qamats commonly represent an a quality; segol and tsere represent e; hiriq represents i; holam and qamats qatan represent o; and qibbuts or shureq represent u. Reduced vowels include shewa and the three ḥataf signs. The written sign, syllable, and stress jointly help determine a vowel's reading. Learn common combinations as patterns, while remembering that spelling conventions vary by word.

didYouKnow: According to OSHB/MorphHB (CC BY 4.0), the most frequent word in this unit is בֹּקֶר (bōqer), occurring 372 times in the Westminster Leningrad Codex.
